4. It is stated by the parties that in the meantime the defendant-petitioners filed Title Suit No. 06 of 2008 before the Second Court of Joint District Judge, Feni seeking declaration of title in respect of Feni properties left by the said Dr. Hashem claiming that the said properties were gifted in their favour by Dr. Hashem and, accordingly, they obtained a decree therein as against which the plaintiffs in the present suit preferred an appeal before the High Court Division, which is still pending. 

 10. This amendment application seems to be an after thought device adopted by the plaintiffs. Probably, they have been prompted to do that after knowing that other heirs of Dr. Hashem in Feni were claiming the Feni properties of Dr. Hashem on the plea of a gift by Dr. Hashem in their favour and that they have already obtained a decree to the effect. We hope that this aspect of Feni properties of Dr. Hashem would be dealt with properly in accordance with law by the Courts concerned at a proper stage in both suits.
